title: Checkout button is not clickable on mobile Safari
description: Users report that the checkout CTA does not respond on mobile Safari after the latest frontend deployment.

title: Billing modal traps keyboard focus
description: Customer admins using keyboard navigation cannot tab out of the billing modal after opening payment settings.

title: Product image carousel renders blank on tablet
description: The product detail image carousel shows an empty frame on tablet widths but works on desktop.

title: Checkout address form drops apartment field
description: Shoppers can submit checkout, but the apartment field disappears when editing a saved address.

title: Mobile navigation menu covers search input
description: Users on small Android screens cannot reach the search input because the navigation overlay covers it.

title: Order confirmation page shows raw translation keys
description: After purchase, customers see raw translation keys instead of localized confirmation text.

title: Public signup page fails contrast check
description: The primary signup button has insufficient color contrast in the public marketing signup flow.

title: Main CI pipeline fails before unit tests
description: The main branch workflow is blocked because the test container cannot start after the runner image update.

title: Merge queue blocked by flaky checkout integration test
description: The checkout integration test fails intermittently and blocks pull requests in the merge queue.

title: Package workflow cannot publish nightly build
description: The nightly package workflow fails at the signing step and prevents downstream teams from testing the build.

title: Lint job fails in three repositories
description: A shared lint configuration update causes the same CI failure across shop-web, admin-web, and api repositories.

title: Docker build stage times out in CI
description: The Docker image build stage times out after twenty minutes and blocks release candidate validation.

title: Documentation spellcheck fails on README link
description: The docs spellcheck job fails because an internal README link was renamed.

title: Revenue dashboard double counts refunded orders
description: The internal revenue dashboard double counts refunded orders in weekly totals.

title: Customer usage report shows stale numbers
description: Customer-facing usage reports show yesterday's values for active seats after the metrics refresh job stalled.

title: Daily active users chart drops mobile sessions
description: The DAU chart excludes mobile sessions after a schema change in the event pipeline.

title: Missing customer records after CRM import
description: Support reports that some imported customer records may be missing, but the affected account list is unclear.

title: Search analytics dashboard has empty category filter
description: The internal search analytics dashboard shows an empty category filter after a taxonomy sync.

title: Billing export CSV has shifted columns
description: Finance reports that the billing export CSV shifts tax and discount columns for enterprise invoices.

title: Product search latency spikes during peak traffic
description: Customers see search result latency above eight seconds during peak shopping hours.

title: Account settings page times out for large teams
description: Enterprise admins with more than 500 seats hit a timeout when opening account settings.

title: Background invoice job uses excessive memory
description: The invoice rendering worker consumes high memory and is restarted by the scheduler overnight.

title: Public pricing page loads slowly in Europe
description: Users in Europe report the public pricing page takes twelve seconds to load after a CDN rule change.

title: Admin audit log query saturates database CPU
description: The audit log query causes sustained database CPU saturation when admins filter by actor.

title: Image resize worker backlog delays thumbnails
description: Thumbnail generation is delayed by a worker backlog but checkout and uploads remain available.

title: Payment SDK dependency no longer installs
description: The package install fails because the pinned payment SDK version was removed from the registry.

title: Python HTTP library conflicts with security scanner
description: The dependency resolver fails because the pinned HTTP library is below the security scanner minimum version.

title: Analytics connector package changed response shape
description: A minor version update of the analytics connector changed a field name and broke nightly metric ingestion.

title: Frontend build fails after UI library upgrade
description: The UI component library upgrade removed a deprecated theme export used by shop-web.

title: Container base image has critical CVE
description: The shared container base image has a critical CVE and needs an urgent dependency update.

title: Dev-only storybook addon fails to install
description: A storybook addon used only in local development has an incompatible peer dependency.

title: Production deploy rolled back after missing environment variable
description: The production release rolled back because a required checkout service environment variable was absent.

title: Staging deployment points to production database
description: The staging release picked up the production database connection string during deployment.

title: Canary release sends traffic to old checkout service
description: The canary deployment routes a small percentage of production checkout traffic to the old service version.

title: Release workflow cannot publish Docker image
description: The release deployment is blocked because the container registry token expired.

title: Feature flag rollout stuck at zero percent
description: A deployment script reports success but the new feature flag remains at zero percent in all environments.

title: Preview environment failed for documentation site
description: The documentation preview environment failed after a static asset path changed.

title: SSO login fails for enterprise users
description: Enterprise customers cannot log in through SSO after the OAuth certificate rotation.

title: Customer admin receives permission denied on billing settings
description: A customer admin with the billing role receives a permission denied page when opening billing settings.

title: Password reset token expires immediately
description: Users report that password reset links expire immediately after email delivery.

title: API tokens cannot be created by project owners
description: Project owners receive an access error when creating API tokens for automation.

title: OAuth callback rejects valid state parameter
description: The OAuth callback intermittently rejects a valid state parameter for browser login flows.

title: Read-only users can open admin export page
description: Read-only internal users can open the admin export page, though export actions are still blocked.

title: Session cookie missing secure attribute in staging
description: A staging security scan reports that the session cookie is missing the secure attribute.

title: Rename old experiment feature flag
description: Clean up an old experiment flag name after the rollout completed.

title: Update issue template copy
description: The default bug report template has a typo and should ask for browser version.

title: Archive unused dashboard screenshot assets
description: Remove outdated dashboard screenshots from the docs asset folder.

title: Add missing owner to CODEOWNERS file
description: The design-system folder needs a CODEOWNERS entry for routine review routing.

title: Schedule quarterly dependency review meeting
description: Create a planning issue for the next quarterly dependency review meeting.

title: Remove deprecated onboarding checklist item
description: The internal onboarding checklist still references a retired local setup step.
